decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the unit is occupied
Condition : 3 - No activity related to the use of the unit as a cable broadcasting and production studio shall take place anywhere on the site except within building known as Unit 1.

Condition : 4 - Before the change of use hereby permitted is commenced a scheme indicating the provision to be made for disabled people to gain access to and within the unit and for disabled toilet facilities shall have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority. The agreed scheme shall be implemented before the change of use hereby permitted is brought into use.

Condition : 5 - C13	The office floorspace contained within the development hereby approved shall be used only as offices ancillary to the main use of the premises as Studio B1(b) Use and shall not be used for any other purpose.

Condition : 6 - The development shall not commence until details of the front door control and lobby area to the office are submitted to and approved by the local planning authority and the works carried out in accordance with the approved details before the development commences.

Condition : 7 - The use hereby permitted shall not commence until full particulars and details of a scheme to protect the proposed use from external transportations noise shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority and any works which form part of a scheme shall be completed before the first part of the development is occupied or used

Condition : 8 - The use hereby permitted shall not commence until full particulars and details of a scheme for the control of noise from mechanical pant including details of sound attenuation has been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority and the development shall  not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any approval given
description: CHANGE OF USE FROM B1(C) LIGHT INDUSTRIAL TO B1(B) STUDIO USE  OF PREMISES  AND RETENTION OF ALTERATIONS TO WINDOWS ON FRONT ELEVATION
